title: Skyline expansion
description: A tech-driven adventure modpack featuring towns to explore, cars to drive, new ores and armor to progress with, and full controller support.
body: Skyline Expansion is a modern tech and exploration modpack that brings together vehicles, industry, and adventure. Travel across the world with cars and aircraft, discover lively towns, and mine powerful new ores to craft advanced gear and armor. Whether you're building, exploring, or progressing through new technology, Skyline Expansion offers a smooth experience with full controller support and plenty of ways to play your way.
